claim_boundary: the historical sample has been visible to earlier CZSC research and is not independent OOS
the 2024plus segment is a locked temporal validation inside this study, not prospective confirmation
a passing result creates a forward-test candidate only
a failing result closes this exact hypothesis without parameter rescue

mechanism.hypothesis: a fresh weekly transition out of a persistent Downtrend into a recovery regime captures short-horizon reversal that remains after same-date industry, size and causal-risk matching
mechanism.distinct_from_closed_delay5: contrarian recovery after state 1, not delayed continuation in states 5-8
mechanism.decision_frequency: dates with a complete frozen daily_basic cross-section
mechanism.primary_exit: 20th common market-session close including the entry session as day 1

execution.entry_gap_rule: finite positive next-session open and gap_pct < board_limit_pct - 0.3
execution.endpoint_price: last observable close at or before the fixed common-session endpoint (LOCF for suspension)
execution.missing_or_delisted_terminal_value: not modelled; reported as a limitation
execution.overlapping_signals: retained for pair ATT; weekly basket diagnostic is equal weight

outcome_blind_matching.control_pool: eligible non-family-event stocks with the same target regime on the same decision date

statistics.weekly_estimand: equal-weight mean treated-trade net ATT within decision date
statistics.development_multiplicity: Holm-adjusted one-sided normal p over the fixed 9-cell H20 family

decision_rules.development_pass: coverage>=0.80, max_abs_smd<=0.10, supported_trades>=60, mean_net_H20_ATT>=0.50%, Holm one-sided p<0.05, bootstrap q05>0, and both development-half means>0
decision_rules.selection: among development-pass cells choose the largest bootstrap q05, then mean ATT, then lexical cell id
decision_rules.validation_pass: locked cell coverage>=0.80, max_abs_smd<=0.10, supported_trades>=40, mean_net_H20_ATT>=0.50%, one-sided HAC p<0.05, bootstrap q05>0, and both validation-half means>0
decision_rules.candidate_status: RETROSPECTIVE_CANDIDATE_FORWARD_TEST_REQUIRED only if both development and validation pass
decision_rules.failure_status: HYPOTHESIS_FALSIFIED_RETROSPECTIVE; no threshold, target-state, duration or horizon rescue
